clauses.reason:
EO 11767 designated the Organization of African Unity under the International Organizations Immunities Act in a single paragraph. Section 3 of EO 13377, signed April 13, 2005 and published at 70 FR 20263 on April 18, 2005, states: "Executive Order 13762 of January 
13, 2017, is revoked." The revocation names the order and has no delayed effective date or exception, so the clause ended on April 13, 2005, the signing date.

conflict_resolutions.NO_ORDER_CITED_IN_CURRENT_LAW: The one current-law lead is a machine snippet of 8 CFR 316.20 (eCFR through 2026-10-14) that lists the Organization of African Unity with the citation E.O. 11767. A regulatory citation list does not continue a designation that an Executive order revoked; EO 13377 section 3 revoked EO 11767 on 2005-04-13 and no held text revives it. The lead is therefore not a current legal predicate for EO 11767.

research_rationale:
EO 11767 of February 19, 1974 (39 FR 6603) consists of one operative paragraph designating the Organization of African Unity as a public international organization under the International Organizations Immunities Act. Section 3 of EO 13377 of April 13, 2005 (70 FR 20263, published April 18, 2005) provides: "Executive Order 11767 of February 19, 1974, is revoked." The order has no own-terms sunset, condition or report date. Searches of the held corpus for the order's number found only EO 13377, the order's own texts, and an eCFR list (8 CFR 316.20) that still names the OAU designation; none revokes, supersedes or amends it earlier. The first and only dated end is the revocation on April 13, 2005.

savings.reason: EO 13377 designates the African Union in section 1, preserves in section 2 only privileges the African Union may otherwise hold, and revokes EO 11767 in section 3 without any saving clause for the OAU designation. The single command of EO 11767 was the designation itself; no continuing independent command or accrued obligation is located in the held texts.
